howto.what: 安装后,Claude 在生成 Windows PowerShell 脚本时会自动套用括号、ASCII 字符、空值检查等规则,避免常见语法错误,产出更稳妥的代码。
howto.when: 当你在 Windows 环境要求编写或修改 PowerShell 脚本时,Claude 会按这些模式处理,尤其是涉及运算符、错误处理或文件路径时。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically apply parentheses, ASCII-only characters, null checks, and other rules when generating Windows PowerShell scripts, avoiding common syntax errors and producing more reliable code.
howto.when_en: This activates when you ask Claude to write or modify PowerShell scripts in a Windows environment, especially when dealing with operators, error handling, or file paths.
